actions.input: 我不攻击无人机，先打爆路灯制造黑暗，然后拖着警察撤到车后。
我对失控机械体喊话，试图让它相信我不是敌人。
actions.expects: possible communication/scan/provisional ruling, not automatic failure

actions.input: 我觉得这把手枪威力很大，想瞄准它的核心位置一枪打爆它。
actions.expects: GM verifies weapon/effect against rules/object facets and resolves automatically; does not accept player-implied extra damage as truth

actions.input: 我继续压制它，不给它转向警察的机会。
我冲进仓库，沿着电缆找控制源。
我不查明显线索，改去问旁边路人刚才听到了什么。
actions.expects: alternate clue path or cost; no dead end

actions.input: I keep it pinned with suppressive fire and move toward cover.
遮蔽物に入りながら、機械を撃ち続ける。
